blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Sisi Rondina-Rosales savored Choco Mucho’s return to the PVL semifinals, ending a yearlong absence as she and Eya Laure helped the Flying Titans complete the Final Four cast of the 2026 All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. Rondina-Rosales powered the Flying Titans with 21 points, all from attacks, while Laure embraced her role as closer with 11 points to oust PLDT, 25-22, 25-23, 18-25, 25-23, on Thursday night at Mall of Asia Arena. The former dynamic duo of University of Santo Tomas, who led their school to a magical runner-up finish in the UAAP Season 81 in 2019, relished the opportunity […]...
